blocks.text: MIN:200–222 DETAILED REVIEW AND DELEGATED APPROVAL — CANONICAL

The packet challenged the mixed Phase 2 meanings against four alternative architectures per root. It scored 45 candidates across 360 criterion values, audited eleven competing families, and ran 61 English Mind concept tests. The pre-approval gate passed 24 checks and all 2,592 deterministic generation assertions. A separate post-migration validation passed 19 checks.

Canonical architecture: the final Mind layer owns selective allocation of cognitive processing. The inward triplet selects attentional capacity; the outward triplet selects a cognizer-to-target attention relation; the systemic triplet selects joint attention.
MIN:200 — enduring attentional capacity — A persistent capacity of a cognizer to allocate cognitive processing selectively.
MIN:201 — available attentional capacity — A cognizer’s capacity to allocate cognitive processing selectively that is presently available for exercise.
MIN:202 — latent attentional capacity — A cognizer’s capacity to allocate cognitive processing selectively that exists without being presently available for exercise.
MIN:210 — established target-attention relation — An established relation in which a cognizer’s cognitive processing is preferentially directed toward a distinct target.
MIN:211 — active target attention — A relation in which a cognizer’s cognitive processing is presently preferentially directed toward a distinct target.
MIN:212 — unresolved target-attention relation — An unresolved attentional relation between a cognizer and a distinct target whose receipt of preferential cognitive processing is undetermined.
MIN:220 — established joint-attention relation — A stable attentional relation among multiple cognizers that gives one target shared cognitive priority.
MIN:221 — active joint attention — An attentional relation in which multiple cognizers presently give the same target shared cognitive priority.
MIN:222 — potential joint attention — An unrealized possible attentional relation in which multiple cognizers would give the same target shared cognitive priority.

Design boundary: MIN:2xx owns attentional capacity and attention relations. It does not make consciousness, sensory input, gaze, representations, learning, inference, belief, truth, goals, communication, agreement, data priority, queues, plans, schedules, or physical implementation part of the atom.
